_about: Comfort Companion catalog. Every plan (Gemini or default) is built only from ids in here. Add a sound, a breathing pattern, grounding lines or a message template without touching code. Support for sensory overload, not medical advice.

sounds.label: Brown noise
sounds.note: Deep, soft rumble that covers a loud room.

sounds.label: Chill music
sounds.note: Slow soft chords made in the browser.

sounds.label: Rain sound
sounds.short: {name}, a soft rain sound can play if you want it.
sounds.normal: {name}, a soft, steady rain sound can play for a while. Stop it whenever you like.

noise: Only this one soft sound is left.
You can stay here as long as you like.
people: Nobody needs anything from you right now.
You are not behind. Nothing is waiting.
Come back when you are ready, not before.
lights: Lower your eyes or close them.
Rest them on one dark, still spot.
Let the room blur. It can wait.
unknown: You don't have to name it.
Too much is a fair answer.
This spot is yours for now.

messages.text: Hey, it's a lot right now. I'm taking a few minutes with my headphones on. I'm okay, just need quiet.
It's too loud for me here. I'm stepping outside for a bit. Back soon.
Things are too much right now. Could you come sit with me? No need to talk.

strategies.label: Slow breathing
strategies.short: {name}, one slow breath in, then a long breath out.
strategies.normal: {name}, if it feels okay, breathe in slowly and let a long breath out. There is no rush.

strategies.label: Soft music
strategies.short: {name}, some soft music could help. Tap play if you want it.
strategies.normal: {name}, some soft, slow music could help for a while. Tap play if you want it, and stop it any time.

strategies.label: Brown noise
strategies.short: {name}, a soft brown noise can cover the room.
strategies.normal: {name}, a soft, deep brown noise can cover the room for a while. Stop it whenever you like.

strategies.label: Rain sound
strategies.short: {name}, a soft rain sound can play if you want it.
strategies.normal: {name}, a soft, steady rain sound can play for a while. Stop it whenever you like.

strategies.label: White noise
strategies.short: {name}, a soft white noise, like a fan, can play if you want it.
strategies.normal: {name}, a soft, even white noise, like a fan, can play for a while. Stop it whenever you like.

strategies.label: Quiet
strategies.normal: {name}, everything can stay quiet for a while. Nothing needs an answer.

strategies.label: Familiar object
strategies.short: {name}, your familiar object is right here if you want it.
strategies.normal: {name}, your familiar object is close by. Hold it if that feels good.

strategies.label: Small movement
strategies.short: {name}, a small movement or fidget is okay.
strategies.normal: {name}, moving a little or using a fidget is completely okay. Take your time.

strategies.label: A quieter spot
strategies.short: {name}, a quieter spot nearby is okay to use.
strategies.normal: {name}, it is okay to move to a quieter spot for a bit. Come back when you are ready.

strategies.label: Just a pause
strategies.short: {name}, nothing needs to happen right now.
strategies.normal: {name}, nothing needs to happen right now. I am here only if you ask.
